image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a vintage audio cassette tape. The casing is black plastic with a white paper label on the top face featuring red handwritten text and some printed black text. Two circular windows reveal the white plastic spools inside, with dark magnetic tape wound around them. A rectangular opening at the bottom exposes the tape path mechanism. The image has a grainy, filtered aesthetic.
